metadata.name: greenhouse__application_enhanced
metadata.comment: Table capturing all candidate and prospect applications. Note that prospect applications can be associated with 0-many jobs. Also, a prospect that converts to a candidate application will have 2 records (the difference is `is_prospect`).

applied_at.name: applied_at
applied_at.comment: Timestamp of when the application was submitted.

candidate_id.name: candidate_id
candidate_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the CANDIDATE who submitted the application.

credited_to_user_id.name: credited_to_user_id
credited_to_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who will receive credit for this application.

current_stage_id.name: current_stage_id
current_stage_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the JOB_STAGE that the application is currently at in the pipeline.

last_activity_at.name: last_activity_at
last_activity_at.comment: Timestamp of when the last activity was taken on this application.

location_address.name: location_address
location_address.comment: The content of the address question on a job post.

is_prospect.name: is_prospect
is_prospect.comment: Boolean that is true if this is a prospect application, which means that the associated person  is a prospect and has not yet applied for this job.

prospect_owner_user_id.name: prospect_owner_user_id
prospect_owner_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER ID of the prospect owner.

prospect_pool_id.name: prospect_pool_id
prospect_pool_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the PROSPECT_POOL that the application came from.

prospect_stage_id.name: prospect_stage_id
prospect_stage_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ID of the application's PROSPECT_POOL_STAGE.

rejected_at.name: rejected_at
rejected_at.comment: Timestamp of when the application was rejected.

rejected_reason_id.name: rejected_reason_id
rejected_reason_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the REJECTION_REASON for the application.

source_id.name: source_id
source_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ID of the SOURCE of the application.

referrer_name.name: referrer_name
referrer_name.comment: Full name of the user who is credited with referring this application.

prospect_owner_name.name: prospect_owner_name
prospect_owner_name.comment: Full name of the prospect owner.

current_company.name: current_company
current_company.comment: The company at which the candidate currently works.

coordinator_user_id.name: coordinator_user_id
coordinator_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who is responsible for coordinating this candidate.

full_name.name: full_name
full_name.comment: First and last name of the candidate.

is_private.name: is_private
is_private.comment: Boolean that is true if the candidate is private.

recruiter_user_id.name: recruiter_user_id
recruiter_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who is the recruiter assigned to this candidate.

last_updated_at.name: last_updated_at
last_updated_at.comment: Timestamp of when the candidate profile was last updated.

phone.name: phone
phone.comment: Comma-separated aggregated list of the candidate's phone numbers and the type of phone they are.

email.name: email
email.comment: Comma-separated list of the candidate's email addresses.

resume_url.name: resume_url
resume_url.comment: URL of the candidate's most recently uploaded resume.

linkedin_url.name: linkedin_url
linkedin_url.comment: URL of the candidate's most recently added LinkedIn link.

github_url.name: github_url
github_url.comment: URL of the candidate's most recently added Github link.

coordinator_name.name: coordinator_name
coordinator_name.comment: Full name of the user who is responsible for coordinating with this candidate.

recruiter_name.name: recruiter_name
recruiter_name.comment: Full name of the candidate's assigned recruiter.

coordinator_email.name: coordinator_email
coordinator_email.comment: Email of the user who is responsible for coordinating with this candidate.

recruiter_email.name: recruiter_email
recruiter_email.comment: Email of the candidate's assigned recruiter.

candidate_created_at.name: candidate_created_at
candidate_created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the candidate profile was created.

candidate_tags.name: candidate_tags
candidate_tags.comment: Comma-separated list of tags attached to this candidate.

current_job_stage.name: current_job_stage
current_job_stage.comment: Current stage that the application is at in the hiring pipeline.

sourced_from.name: sourced_from
sourced_from.comment: Where the application was sourced from.

sourced_from_type.name: sourced_from_type
sourced_from_type.comment: The category of source that the application came from.

count_activities.name: count_activities
count_activities.comment: Total count of activities completed on this candidate's profile.

job_title.name: job_title
job_title.comment: Title of the job role the candidate is applying for.

job_status.name: job_status
job_status.comment: Current status of the job being applied for.

hiring_managers.name: hiring_managers
hiring_managers.comment: Comma-separated list of the full names of the job's hiring managers.

job_id.name: job_id
job_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the JOB being applied for.

job_requisition_id.name: job_requisition_id
job_requisition_id.comment: The id of the requisition corresponding to this job posting, if applicable.

job_sourcers.name: job_sourcers
job_sourcers.comment: Comma-separated list of the full names of the job's recruiting sourcers.

job_offices.name: job_offices
job_offices.comment: Semicolon-separated list of the offices that the job is listed under.

job_departments.name: job_departments
job_departments.comment: Semicolon-separated list of the departments that the job is listed under.

job_parent_departments.name: job_parent_departments
job_parent_departments.comment: Semicolon-separated list of the *parent* departments that the job is listed under.

prospect_pool.name: prospect_pool
prospect_pool.comment: Name given to the applicant's prospect pool.

prospect_stage.name: prospect_stage
prospect_stage.comment: Current stage of the applicant within its prospect pool, if applicable.

candidate_gender.name: candidate_gender
candidate_gender.comment: Description of the applicant's gender identity.

candidate_disability_status.name: candidate_disability_status
candidate_disability_status.comment: Description of the applicant's disability status.

candidate_veteran_status.name: candidate_veteran_status
candidate_veteran_status.comment: Description of the applicant's veteran status.

application_job_key.name: application_job_key
application_job_key.comment: Unique key hashed on `application_id`, `job_id`, and `source_relation`. This has to be done as the table contains both candidates and prospects.

has_interviewed_w_hiring_manager.name: has_interviewed_w_hiring_manager
has_interviewed_w_hiring_manager.comment: Boolean that is true if the applicant has interviewed with one of the job's hiring managers.

count_interviews.name: count_interviews
count_interviews.comment: Total number of interviews had (1 interview with a panel of 3 interviewers = 1).

count_interview_scorecards.name: count_interview_scorecards
count_interview_scorecards.comment: Count of feedback scorecards given (1 interview with a panel of 3 interviewers = 3).

count_distinct_interviewers.name: count_distinct_interviewers
count_distinct_interviewers.comment: Count of internal users that the candidate has interviewed with.

latest_interview_scheduled_at.name: latest_interview_scheduled_at
latest_interview_scheduled_at.comment: The latest time that the candidate was scheduled to be interviewed at (can be in the future).

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

recruiter_name.name: recruiter_name
recruiter_name.comment: Full name of the application's recruiter.

hiring_managers.name: hiring_managers
hiring_managers.comment: Hiring manager(s) for the pursued job.

sourced_from.name: sourced_from

sourced_from_type.name: sourced_from_type

job_title.name: job_title
job_title.comment: Title of the job role the candidate is applying for.

job_id.name: job_id
job_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the JOB being applied for.

candidate_id.name: candidate_id
candidate_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the unique CANDIDATE associated with this application.

days_in_stage.name: days_in_stage
days_in_stage.comment: Number of calendar days the application spent in this stage.

job_departments.name: job_departments
job_departments.comment: Semicolon-separated list of the departments that the job is listed under.

job_parent_departments.name: job_parent_departments
job_parent_departments.comment: Semicolon-separated list of the *parent* departments that the job is listed under.

job_offices.name: job_offices
job_offices.comment: Semicolon-separated list of the offices that the job is listed under.

candidate_gender.name: candidate_gender
candidate_gender.comment: Description of the applicant's gender identity.

candidate_disability_status.name: candidate_disability_status

candidate_veteran_status.name: candidate_veteran_status

count_activities_in_stage.name: count_activities_in_stage
count_activities_in_stage.comment: Total count of the activities performed while the candidate was in this stage.

metadata.name: greenhouse__interview_enhanced
metadata.comment: Table of **scheduled** interviews joined with interviewer scorecards. Each record is unique to the  interview and interviewer and is enriched with data about the applicant and job.

application_id.name: application_id
application_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the APPLICATION that is being interviewed.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the interview was created.

end_at.name: end_at
end_at.comment: Timestamp of when the interview is scheduled to end. Will be a date if the interview is all-day.

scheduled_interview_id.name: scheduled_interview_id
scheduled_interview_id.comment: Unique ID of the scheduled interview.

interview_id.name: interview_id
interview_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the id of the generic INTERVIEW step that this scheduled interview maps to.

organizer_user_id.name: organizer_user_id
organizer_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who organized the interview.

start_at.name: start_at
start_at.comment: Timestamp of when the interview is scheduled to start. Will be a date if the interview is all-day.

last_updated_at.name: last_updated_at
last_updated_at.comment: Timestamp of when the interview was last updated.

job_stage_id.name: job_stage_id
job_stage_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the JOB_STAGE that this interview is associated with.

duration_interview_minutes.name: duration_interview_minutes
duration_interview_minutes.comment: From start the finish, the length of the interview in minutes.

candidate_id.name: candidate_id
candidate_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the CANDIDATE who was interviewed and scored.

overall_recommendation.name: overall_recommendation
overall_recommendation.comment: One of - definitely_not, no, yes, strong_yes, no_decision.

scorecard_submitted_at.name: scorecard_submitted_at
scorecard_submitted_at.comment: Timestamp of when the scorecard was submitted.

scorecard_submitted_by_user_id.name: scorecard_submitted_by_user_id
scorecard_submitted_by_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who submitted the scorecard.

scorecard_last_updated_at.name: scorecard_last_updated_at
scorecard_last_updated_at.comment: Timestamp of when the scorecard was last updated.

interviewer_user_id.name: interviewer_user_id
interviewer_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER conducting the interview.

interviewer_name.name: interviewer_name
interviewer_name.comment: Full name of the interviewer user.

scorecard_submitter_name.name: scorecard_submitter_name
scorecard_submitter_name.comment: Full name of the user who submitted the scorecard (either the interviewer or on behalf of the interviewer).

organizer_name.name: organizer_name
organizer_name.comment: Full name of the user who organized the interview.

job_stage.name: job_stage
job_stage.comment: Name of the job stage step that this interview is associated with.

application_current_job_stage.comment: Current job stage of the application. If this is diferent from `job_stage`,  the candidate advanced after this interview.

job_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the JOB being interviewed for.
